Right row: line 3627 "Marneus Calgar in Armour of Antilochus 50mm" is the guide's only Calgar row. In the 11th-edition datasheet he is a single model (Wahapedia ultramarines_Marneus-Calgar shows just "Marneus Calgar (⌀50mm)"; the Victrix Honour Guard have their own row), so no other base is missing. The guide has "Warboss 40mm" (line 3535) and "Warboss (Armageddon) 50mm" (line 3536). The owner says this model is the Armageddon Warboss on 50mm. New Recruit shooty.txt line 353, BSData and Wahapedia all give 50mm. The declaration only covers orks/warboss, which is used only in the shooty list. The gate fails if the lookup ever finds that row by itself.

Line 3539 does print "Wazdakka Gutsmek 120mm". It is the only round 120mm in the guide, and "120x92mm Oval Base" appears on 65 lines (I counted them). Wahapedia (⌀120 x 92mm), BSData Orks.json line 33403 and New Recruit shooty.txt line 221 all give 120x92mm. The owner decided it is oval. The gate re-checks that GW still prints "120mm". The reasoning holds.

"Nazdreg" appears nowhere in the guide (ORKS section 3475-3546 checked by hand). Wahapedia orks_Nazdreg gives ⌀60mm, and New Recruit melee.txt line 37 and ooga-booga.txt line 41 give 60mm. App 60mm. The gate fails if the guide ever adds a row.

No "Sentinel" in the ADEPTUS CUSTODES section (lines 2603-2634). The guide's only Sentinel rows are the Astra Militarum Armoured/Scout Sentinels. "Custodian Guard with Adrasite and Pyrithite Spears" is a different Forge World unit. Wahapedia gives ⌀40mm, and New Recruit emperors-chosen.txt line 93 and dread-host.txt line 94 give 40mm. App 40mm.

Typos in an app base string are caught: the gate compares it exactly with GW's value and checks the declared ones against FORM. Unused declarations fail, and so do stale ones (a guide:null row that now exists in the guide, a declaration the lookup makes unnecessary, gwError text that changed). But two kinds of wrong base pass. (1) If a model row's name does not match the guide's "Unit: Model" row, the check falls back to the unit's own row without warning. So the Tankbustas "Nob" passes at 32mm against "Tankbustas 32mm" (line 3531), although GW line 3532 says "Tankbustas: Boss Nob 40mm" (Wahapedia also gives Nob ⌀40mm). (2) Only stats rows are checked, so a model merged into a stats row is never compared. The Skitarii Ranger with a transuranic arquebus (purge-goes-the-foe, 1 per unit, 2 units) needs 60×35.5mm Oval (line 2666, and Wahapedia "60 x 35mm if equipped with transuranic arquebus"), but it is counted as 25mm.
fix: Fail when a unit's guide section has a "<unit>: <model>" row (or "<unit>/…: <model>") that no stats row of the unit matched and no declaration covers. Also check the unit's `models` entries (gear such as a transuranic arquebus) against such rows. Then fix data.js: orks/tankbustas "Nob" base '40mm' (GW line 3532 "Tankbustas: Boss Nob"; shooty, 2 units), with NR/BSData deviations for their 32mm. Skitarii Rangers: give the arquebus model its own base, 60×35.5mm Oval (GW line 2666; purge-goes-the-foe, 2 units: Bases to print 18× 25mm + 2× 60×35.5mm Oval instead of 20× 25mm).

why: The five fixed lookups are right; I checked each by hand: Sir Hekhtur at line 3348 is 25mm, Jakhals: Dishonoured at 3890 is 40mm, Neurogaunts: Nodebeasts at 3828 is 28.5mm, Dark Apostle: Dark Disciple at 3033 is 25mm, and Gretchin: Runtherd at 3504 is 32mm. The parser also handles the wrapped "Wardens of Ultramar" and "Masters of the Maelstrom" rows. But the "model" step only matches when every word of the guide's model name is in the app's model name. So the app's "Nob" does not match "Tankbustas: Boss Nob", and the lookup returns "Tankbustas 32mm" (line 3531) as an exact match. GW gives 40mm. The same would happen for "Boyz: Boss Nob (Armageddon)" and "Breaka Boyz: Boss Nob".
fix: lookup: when the unit has "<unit>: <model>" rows, a model row whose name is a proper subset of the guide model's words (Nob ⊂ Boss Nob) must match that row (or return null so the gate asks for a declaration). It must not fall through to the unit's own row. Result for Tankbustas/Nob: "Tankbustas: Boss Nob" 40mm, line 3532.

why: from-json.js checks declared() before lookup, with the same datasheet id (faction/slug) and model, so a re-import keeps the Warboss at 50mm (Armageddon row), Wazdakka at the declared 120×92mm Oval, and Nazdreg and Sentinel Guard from Wahapedia. The source note names the declaration. Small issue: if a declared guide row vanished, declared() would return base undefined and the row would be silently left alone, but the bases gate would then fail on the missing row. It shares lookup's Tankbustas Boss Nob problem (see the base-guide.js item), and a re-import would keep 32mm until that is fixed.
